verify_note: Central anecdote (Otto Loewi's dreamed frog-heart experiment, Nobel 1936) could not be tied to Pang's Rest: no source places Loewi in the book. Rest has a Sleep chapter (ch. 9) and the claim that sleep is active and supports creativity, but no verifiable concrete case or study from it was found, so a faithful 4-language story cannot be built. Old-text year details (1903, 1920) are also contested in sources (1920 vs 1921).
